meta.article_eligibility_semantics: Explicit output_type=articles; legacy registry entries excluding parts collectors. This is collector coverage, not independent publisher coverage.

meta.language_semantics: Language counts use only explicit record metadata. Script signals are Unicode character-family observations and do not identify a language. Latin-script does not mean English.
meta.geography_semantics: Registered geography is the registry's source focus/location label. Explicit article geography is counted only from structured article fields. Candidate-event regions are keyword-derived mentions. None is a full geopolitical coverage or event-location assessment.
meta.temporal_semantics: Coverage dates are article publication dates, not collector run times or event occurrence dates. Missing publication days do not prove a miner did not run or that no relevant activity occurred.
meta.collector_health_semantics: Explicit collector status, run time and successful endpoint evidence determine execution health; successful no-match runs count as executed. Missing endpoint evidence falls back to a labeled publication-date proxy. last_seen remains evidence time and does not advance on a successful run; execution health does not prove fresh evidence.
meta.source_semantics: Source keys and site labels are collection buckets, not verified independent publishers. Syndication and shared ownership can remain.
meta.caveat: Observed collection coverage only. The matrix does not measure every available source, language, geography, classified channel, private feed, or unindexed record. Absence from this artifact is not evidence of absence.

alerts.detail: 10.5% of article records lack a parseable publication date.
4,878 records repeat a canonical URL; a shared URL may be a duplicate story or a rolling source and is not resolved here.
23 active registered collectors are stale, unreported, degraded, or future-dated under their declared schedule.
10 observed source keys are not represented in the 72-source registry.
